mapper.sql: id, source_type, source_business_id, author_user_id, title, source_name, source_author, source_url, file_name, document_type, pet_type, category, original_content, cleaned_content, content_checksum, consent_status, status, risk_level, risk_labels, ai_summary, quality_score, current_version, reviewer_user_id, reviewed_at, published_document_id, source_published_at, published_at, expires_at, error_message, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_submission_version (id, submission_id, version, title, original_content, cleaned_content, content_checksum, ai_summary, risk_level, risk_labels, quality_score, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{submissionId}, #{version}, #{title}, #{originalContent}, #{cleanedContent}, #{contentChecksum}, #{aiSummary}, #{riskLevel}, #{riskLabels}, #{qualityScore}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO knowledge_review_record (id, submission_id, version, reviewer_user_id, action, trust_level, reason, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{submissionId}, #{version}, #{reviewerUserId}, #{action}, #{trustLevel}, #{reason}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM knowledge_submission WHERE source_type = #{sourceType} AND source_business_id = #{sourceBusinessId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_submission WHERE author_user_id = #{authorUserId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_submission WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_submission WHERE risk_level = 'HIGH' AND status = 'PENDING_REVIEW'
SELECT id, submission_id, version, reviewer_user_id, action, trust_level, reason, created_at FROM knowledge_review_record WHERE submission_id = #{submissionId} ORDER BY created_at, id
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_submission SET cleaned_content = #{cleanedContent}, content_checksum = #{contentChecksum}, ai_summary = #{summary}, risk_level = #{riskLevel}, risk_labels = #{riskLabels}, quality_score = #{qualityScore}, status = 'PENDING_REVIEW', error_message = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND current_version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'PRECHECKING'

UPDATE knowledge_submission SET title = #{title}, original_content = #{content}, pet_type = #{petType}, category = #{category}, cleaned_content = NULL, content_checksum = NULL, consent_status = 'GRANTED', status = 'PRECHECKING', risk_level = NULL, risk_labels = NULL, ai_summary = NULL, quality_score = NULL, current_version = #{newVersion}, reviewer_user_id = NULL, reviewed_at = NULL, published_document_id = NULL, published_at = NULL, error_message = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND author_user_id = #{authorUserId} AND status IN ('REJECTED', 'WITHDRAWN', 'FAILED')
